### Headline summary
- Iranian actors are attributed with cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration controllers by U.S. and French authorities. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/us-agencies-warn-refrigeration.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202730/hacking/cisa-and-the-fbi-warn-of-attacks-against-industrial-refrigeration-controllers.html))
- Hackers are actively exploiting the OpenSSH SSHole authentication bypass vulnerability and a SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN flaw that bypasses multi-factor authentication. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/openssh-sshole-flaw-exploited/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/hackers-exploiting-sshole-authentication-bypass-in-openssh/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-flags-sonicwall-sonicos-mfa-bypass.html), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/09/exploited-sonicwall-ssl-vpn-flaw-lets-attackers-bypass-saml-enforced-mfa-cve-2026-19868/))
- A French bank lost an estimated $133 million after attackers exploited a service provider platform. ([Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/09/credit-mutuel-arkea-cyberattack-133-million/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/crdit-mutuel-arka-targeted/))

### Cyberattacks on Refrigeration Controllers
U.S. agencies and French authorities have warned of and attributed cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration controllers to Iranian actors, with the French government specifically blaming Iran for the incidents. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/us-agencies-warn-refrigeration.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202730/hacking/cisa-and-the-fbi-warn-of-attacks-against-industrial-refrigeration-controllers.html), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/09/copeland-xweb-refrigeration-controllers-spam-botnet/), [ZATAZ](https://www.zataz.com/cyberattaque-des-frigos-la-piste-iranienne-se-precise/))

### OpenSSH SSHole Vulnerability Exploitation
Hackers are actively exploiting the OpenSSH SSHole authentication bypass vulnerability, a development highlighted in weekly security recaps alongside other recent threats. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/openssh-sshole-flaw-exploited/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/hackers-exploiting-sshole-authentication-bypass-in-openssh/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/weekly-recap-sshole-exploited-apt-root.html), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-exploit-sshole-openssh-flaw-to-breach-linux-systems/))

### CISA Warns of SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Vulnerability
CISA added a SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list, noting that the flaw allows attackers to bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-flags-sonicwall-sonicos-mfa-bypass.html), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/09/exploited-sonicwall-ssl-vpn-flaw-lets-attackers-bypass-saml-enforced-mfa-cve-2026-19868/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/sonicwall-sonicos-sslvpn-vulnerability-exploited/))

### Hackers steal $133 million from Crédit Mutuel Arkéa
Attackers exploited a service provider platform to siphon an estimated $133 million (or €100 million) from the French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa. ([Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/09/credit-mutuel-arkea-cyberattack-133-million/), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/crdit-mutuel-arka-targeted/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/hackers-steal-e100m-credit-mutuel-arkea-supplier-platform/))

### Plex2Shell flaws exploited against QNAP NAS devices
Threat actors are exploiting a chain of four flaws in the Plex Media Server application to hack QNAP NAS devices, prompting the vendor to urge users to update. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/plex2shell-exploited-against-qnap-nas-users/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202708/cyber-crime/qnap-warns-users-as-plex2shell-flaws-are-used-to-hack-nas-devices.html))

### Default Credentials Used to Exploit ForgeRock RCE in Cars
Researchers used default admin:admin credentials to exploit a ForgeRock remote code execution vulnerability, allowing them to remotely unlock and start cars from two automakers. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/default-adminadmin-server-password.html), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/forgerock-attack-chain/))

### Qubole Cross-Account Access Abused to Breach AWS Accounts
A threat actor abused IAM credentials from Qubole's AWS account to assume integration roles, leading to breaches of multiple customer accounts and data theft. ([wiz.io](https://www.wiz.io/blog/qubole-cross-account-access-abused-in-the-wild), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-quboles-trusted-aws.html))

### Hackers Compromise Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop to Deliver Wallet-Stealing Malware
Attackers used the Ethersphere project's own release automation to publish malicious versions of two of its tools for the Swarm decentralized storage network: bee-js 13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop 0.56.2.
